items.title: Jon Jang interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 17, 2003 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: the classical orchestra, violin concerto, that was composed by Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai in 1958

ctx.x: The soul jazz thing, yeah. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

And so he tears it up. And the Chinese musicians love it. Now that’s the Chinese musicians in the United States, and possibly the young Chinese musicians. But if you brought it over to China, which we did, in Beijing, the Beijing International Jazz Festival in 1997, they’re so used to hearing the “Butterfly Lover” song the way it’s performed by the classical orchestra, violin concerto, that was composed by Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai in 1958, that they just can’t accept it. In fact they don’t even want to see…
That’s really interesting. If I was to go to Beijing and turn on the most popular radio station, can you describe what I’m likely to hear?
